<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author, price)>
  <!ATTLIST book id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ATTLIST book available (yes|no) "yes">
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright 2023 Example Corp.">
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://example.com/ext.dtd">
  %ext;
]>

  <book id="b1" available="yes">
    <title>XML Parsing Guide</title>
    <author>Jane Doe</author>
    <price>29.99</price>
  </book>
  <book id="b2" available="no">
    <title>Advanced Fuzzing Techniques</title>
    <author>John Smith</author>
    <price>49.99</price>
  </book>
  <!-- ©right; -->
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE test [
  <!ELEMENT test (note)*>
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, heading, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "Tove">
  <!ENTITY viewer "Jani">
  <!ENTITY % parameter-entity "<!ENTITY internal 'internal-value'>">
  %parameter-entity;
]>
<test>
  <note>
    <to>&viewer;</to>
    <from>&writer;</from>
    <heading>Reminder</heading>
    <body>Don't forget the meeting this weekend! &internal;</body>
  </note>
</test>
